page_title: Turn drawings into Objective-C code with PaintCode 3

sources.entry: PaintCode - Vector drawing app that generates Objective-C or Swift code in real time.

summary.name: PaintCode
summary.one_liner: PaintCode is a vector drawing app that generates resolution-independent Objective-C, Swift, Java, C#, JavaScript or SVG code from your drawings.
use_cases: Drawing iOS user interface elements as code
Handing off designer vector artwork to developers
Converting PDF, SVG, PSD, AI or EPS artwork into code
Animating or controlling shape attributes with variables
summary.what_it_does: PaintCode is a vector drawing app where you draw shapes and it generates code in real time. Supported export languages named on the page are Swift, Objective-C, Java, C#, JavaScript and SVG. It can import PDF, SVG, PSD, AI and EPS documents. All drawings are exported into a single code file called StyleKit, which can be re-exported to update drawings in an app. Variables and expressions can control color, position, rotation, visibility and other shape attributes.
notable: Generates Objective-C, Swift and other language code from vector drawings in real time
